claim_text: Bacon said that in 1996, when the United States was not at war, he served aboard an aircraft carrier enforcing the southern no-fly zone over Iraq and that a couple of crew members jumped overboard and died by suicide during that deployment.
quote: "We had a couple members jump overboard and commit suicide while I was on that deployment," Bacon said.
confidence_justification: A public official's recollection of a 30-year-old deployment; no records cited to corroborate it.
